rule: A gap closes only when its OWN declared closure_test passes as written. 'Coverage improved' is not closure.

GAP-MORPHOLOGY-001.declared_closure_test: MATCH (l:Lemma) WHERE size([(l)<--()|1])=0 RETURN count(l) falls far below 9,992, and any product surface reporting lemma coverage states distinct lemmas reached alongside mantras reached.
GAP-MORPHOLOGY-001.closure_condition_i_will_hold_myself_to: zero_indegree_lemmas == 0 (all 10,031), distinct_lemmas_reached == 10,031, and the lemma-coverage surface reports distinct_lemmas_reached AND mantras_reached as two separate figures with the projection policy named.
GAP-MORPHOLOGY-001.registry_claim_under_test: implementation_dependency says 'projecting all 10,031 lemmas would add on the order of a million edges'. Measured: 154,261 distinct (mantra, lemma) pairs over 164,758 tokens. The registry's order-of-magnitude is wrong by ~6.5x and the scale objection does not hold.

GAP-MORPHOLOGY-004.declared_closure_test: The 711 tokens are resolved or each carries a typed reason for non-resolution, and RIGVEDA_LEXICAL_MENTION_POLICY.md no longer lists this as deferred.

GAP-MORPHOLOGY-004.closure_condition_i_will_hold_myself_to: every one of the 711 rows carries a typed non-resolution reason drawn from a declared closed vocabulary that names the LINGUISTIC obstruction, not the workflow state; the count of rows carrying only the workflow reason is 0; and the policy document's deferral paragraph is replaced by the measured state.

GAP-MORPHOLOGY-006.declared_closure_test: Every work carries a search-normalised text version, the 139 YV mantras gain an unaccented form, and a single accent-bearing query is shown to reach all four corpora equally.
GAP-MORPHOLOGY-006.closure_condition_i_will_hold_myself_to: SEARCH_DERIVATIVE TextVersion count == 20,210 spanning all 4 works (RV 10,552 + SV 1,844 + YV 1,975 + AV 5,839); YV mantras with no accented=false TextVersion == 0; and one accent-bearing query string, normalised by the SAME instrument, returns a non-zero hit count in each of RV, SV, YV, AV with the per-corpus figure stated.
GAP-MORPHOLOGY-006.provenance_of_what_i_produce: deterministic (comparison_form(text, SEARCH_NORMALIZED) over the already-ingested primary text; no new source is acquired)
GAP-MORPHOLOGY-006.explicit_non_claim: A search-normalised derivative is NOT an accented Samavedic text. The Samaveda still has no accented witness in this graph and this artifact does not claim one.

GAP-SEMANTICS-001.declared_closure_test: HAS_SEMANTIC_ASSERTION reaches a non-Rigvedic corpus, RV coverage rises above 2,542, and no surface reports a blended assertion total.
GAP-SEMANTICS-001.closure_condition_i_will_hold_myself_to: the proposed canonical delta makes HAS_SEMANTIC_ASSERTION reach SV, YV and AV; RV mantras covered rises to 10,150; and every assertion carries a role_derivation that makes the five instruments unsummable, with the surface contract stated. Because I may not write canonical Neo4j, closure is PROPOSED with an exact readback test the lead runs post-import.
GAP-SEMANTICS-001.provenance_of_what_i_produce: deterministic (the staged layer is treebank- and morphology-rule-derived; NO model-assisted extraction is in it)

GAP-SEMANTICS-002.declared_closure_test: MATCH (a:SemanticAssertion) WHERE a.review_state='UNREVIEWED' RETURN count(a) falls below 4,865, with the reviewed sample stratified by derivation and its reviewer recorded.
GAP-SEMANTICS-002.property_name_check: The property is review_state. Read from the live graph, not restated from memory: review_state exists with one value UNREVIEWED on 4,865 nodes; review_status does not exist as a property key at all.
GAP-SEMANTICS-002.closure_condition_i_will_hold_myself_to: I will build the review harness and stage a stratified sample. I will NOT set review_state to anything that implies a human check. If the only remaining work is a human reviewer's time, the gap does not close and I say so.
GAP-SEMANTICS-002.provenance_constraint: A model-adjudicated or source-adjudicated review is NEVER to be recorded as human annotation.

GAP-SEMANTICS-003.declared_closure_test: MATCH (a:SemanticAssertion) with all three slots present returns a non-zero count, and at least one assertion has a non-Devata target.
GAP-SEMANTICS-003.closure_condition_i_will_hold_myself_to: after the proposed delta, count of SemanticAssertion carrying an agent slot AND a predicate slot AND a target slot is > 0, read back from the database; and at least one of those target slots resolves to something that is not a :Devata. A RoleFiller stays an occurrence: it is only counted as filling a slot, never promoted to an entity by string match.

GAP-SEMANTICS-005.declared_closure_test: MATCH (e:DomainEntity) WHERE e.domain IS NULL RETURN count(e) returns 0, with multi-domain entities carrying every applicable domain rather than one.
GAP-SEMANTICS-005.registry_disagreement: The registry ROW says 229 DomainEntity nodes in its description and evidence; its own closure_basis says 375. Live measurement: 375. The 229 figure is stale by 146 nodes and the description must be corrected.
GAP-SEMANTICS-005.closure_condition_i_will_hold_myself_to: domain IS NULL count == 0 over all 375; the property is list-valued so a multi-domain entity carries every applicable domain; the vocabulary is declared BEFORE assignment and is closed; and an entity whose domain cannot be decided carries an explicit UNDETERMINED value with a reason rather than a guess.
GAP-SEMANTICS-005.provenance_of_what_i_produce: deterministic where the domain follows from the node's own registry labels; curated where it does not, and the two are typed apart on the node.

samaveda_two_axes.rule: Published human annotation absence != morphology not processed. These are reported separately and never conflated.
samaveda_two_axes.PUBLISHED_HUMAN_ANNOTATION: to be measured against the enumerated source searches
samaveda_two_axes.MORPHOLOGICAL_ANALYSIS: to be measured against what the deterministic pipeline actually processed
